design: DS-V4.1 HBM accelerator, TP-96, 4 HBM3E stacks a die (4.0 TB/s peak)
minimum_component: one HBM3E stack (32 PCs, REFpb on schedule, refresh live); die = 4 identical stacks
bench: rtl/test/hbm_accel/tb_dshbm_1m_streams.sv on rtl/hbm_accel/service/ot_hbm_accel_expert_stream_pc.sv (52ce3e9c1 r6 stream PC + notice) + ot_hbm_accel_cdc_fifo landing; ASSUMED path terms PHY_CMD 5 ns + RSP 10 ns + NoC 5 ns (R5a bench)

metrics.first_access: go (query / merge / token start) -> first sector at the consumer
metrics.complete: go -> last sector at the consumer (the on-path time)
metrics.steady: bytes / (first RD -> last RD burst end)

exactness: every consumed sector compared with its stored pattern (distinct per sector), 0 DRAM timing violations at the corrected REFpb rules; negative controls must FAIL

ckv_selection.rule: sel = global top-512 of the layer index scores (max first, lowest index on ties: w19_hbm_tp96_isa op_merge); owner die = (i // 8) % 96 (key_owner, KEY_BLOCK 8); stack within the die ASSUMED (i // 8 // 96) % 4 (the die interleaves its key blocks over its four stacks)

summary.steady_rule: next token streams from this token's head start (window 15.7 MB)
summary.note: demand during SM-busy exceeds the sustained stream only where the SMs run a layer's matvecs faster than the HBM can deliver them; the static stream runs ahead (prefetch window) so the composer charges only the steady_decode_stall_us (cold_first_token_stall_us for a first token); routed experts are the fetch term (sel90)

default_on_path.rule: owner >= 90 % bandwidth rule (2026-10-04): the index-key scans and the window rows are posted with the static-schedule notice (the descriptors are known before the query); token-dependent loads stay as built.  Composer: tools/dshbm_1m_allmeasured.py Hbm.MODE = "default"
default_on_path.pc_checker: rtl/test/ot_hbm_pc_dram_check.sv bound into every PC when the run used --chk

below_90pct.note: random-row gathers and single-row reads are latency-bound by construction (a few sectors a PC): time, not bandwidth, is their measure
